decision: NX-035 design §3.2 (D1-D8 settled): the first version of the backup plan, read by doctor --backup with bounded validation. Weekly full, daily differential, optional 6-hourly incremental PG backups; continuous WAL archiving with archive_timeout 60 s; every backup verified; file snapshots every 15 minutes; PITR window 14 days and one monthly full kept at most 35 days (D4); restore journal exported every minute (lag over 5 minutes alerts). The limits below are what doctor --backup checks against the backup block of the M12 snapshot (numbers only); grace covers one missed run.
